text: ▶ Is Apple's New iPhone XR A Flop? That's "Bologna" 00:45 Tim Cook has dismissed as "bologna" speculation that Apple's iPhone XR is a flop. In an interview with Jim Cramer, Cook said that since Apple started shipping the XR, it's been the most popular iPhone every day.
